ListAttachments only returns the current user's attachments. It does not enforce memo visibility.

The final list will be organized by enforcement helper, API handler, HTTP router, and real-time notification sites. Distinct sites include `checkMemoReadAccess`, `batchConvertMemoRelations`, and duplicate `canViewerAccessMemo` implementations in `email.go` and `user_service_notifications.go`.

Visibility levels are PUBLIC, PROTECTED, and PRIVATE. Admin bypass is inconsistent: `checkMemoReadAccess` does not grant it for private memos, but the reaction service and file server do. The response will be grouped into core read-access gates and list or query scoping.

GetMemoByShare grants view access through valid share tokens. CreateMemoComment blocks private memos to non-creators and protected memos to unauthenticated users. ListMemoRelations filters related memos without verifying the caller can read the source memo. Indirect exposure routes include attachments, SSE, notifications, and share links.

Here are the distinct server-side memo **view** enforcement sites in this repo (Memos / usememos). The store layer only defines `Visibility` and applies query filters; all enforcement lives under `server/`.

---

**Central access helpers**

- `checkMemoReadAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`39–68`): archived memos creator-only (`44–53`); non-`PUBLIC` requires auth (`55–62`); `PRIVATE` creator-only (`63–64`).
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` (`422–455`): linked attachments inherit memo visibility (`436–454`); unlinked attachments creator/admin-only (`426–433`).
- `checkAttachmentPermission` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` (`650–704`): HTTP `/file/attachments/...`; public+anonymous instance (`677–678`); share-token bypass (`684–688`); private creator/admin (`699–701`).
- `canViewerAccessMemo` (email) — `server/notification/email.go` (`306–320`): used before sending memo comment/mention emails (`155`, `187`).
- `canViewerAccessMemo` (API notifications) — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (`302–316`): gates notification payloads (`337–343`, `370–371`, `385`).
- `canUserAccessMentionContext` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go` (`56–72`): via `shouldSkipMentionInbox` (`74–88`) controls whether mention inboxes are created.
- `SSEClient.canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (`134–144`): filters live memo events by `event.Visibility` / `event.CreatorID` in `Broadcast` (`123–124`).

---

**gRPC/Connect memo read paths**

- `GetMemo` (+ parent memo) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`356–368`): calls `checkMemoReadAccess` on memo and parent.
- `ListMemos` query scoping — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`188–227`): archived creator-only (`188–195`); anonymous → `PUBLIC` only (`218–219`); authed filter `creator_id == … || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` (`221–223`); viewing another user’s profile → `PUBLIC`+`PROTECTED` (`224–225`).
- `ListMemoComments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (`148–178`): `checkMemoReadAccess` on parent (`148`); comment relation `MemoFilter` by visibility (`156–178`).
- `CreateMemoComment` (pre-view gate) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` (`33–42`): blocks commenting on others’ `PRIVATE` memos.
- `ListMemoReactions` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (`29–40`): inline non-`PUBLIC` / `PRIVATE` checks.
- `UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go` (`82–84`): inline `PRIVATE` creator/admin check.
- `ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` (`213–224`): inline visibility gate before listing attachments.
- `GetAttachment` — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go` (`255–257`): delegates to `checkAttachmentAccess`.
- `batchConvertMemoRelations` / `loadMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` (`182–187`, `291–296`): `MemoFilter` limits which related memos appear in relation payloads.
- `ListMemoRelations` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` (`107–131`): same `MemoFilter` pattern on outgoing/incoming relations.
- `GetMemoByShare` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go` (`153–166`): alternate read path via valid non-expired share token (`getActiveMemoShare` `199–207`); archived memos hidden (`164–165`).

---

**Stats / discovery (memo-derived visibility)**

- `ListAllUserStats` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go` (`77–91`): same archived / anonymous / cross-user visibility scoping as `ListMemos`.
- `GetUserStats` — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go` (`217–221`): anonymous → `PUBLIC`; viewing another user → `PUBLIC`+`PROTECTED`.
- `GetExploreRSS` — `server/router/rss/rss.go` (`88–91`): `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`.
- `GetUserRSS` — `server/router/rss/rss.go` (`138–141`): creator-scoped + `PUBLIC` only.
- `getSitemapXML` — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go` (`149–150`): sitemap lists `PUBLIC` memos only.

---

**Indirect exposure (notifications / files / SSE)**

- Memo comment email suppression — `server/notification/email.go` (`148–156`): `buildMemoCommentEmailMessage` + `canViewerAccessMemo`.
- Memo mention email suppression — `server/notification/email.go` (`181–188`): `buildMemoMentionEmailMessage` + `canViewerAccessMemo`.
- Memo comment notification payload — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (`330–343`): `convertMemoCommentNotificationPayload` + `canViewerAccessMemo`.
- Memo mention notification payload — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go` (`363–393`): `convertMemoMentionNotificationPayload` + `canViewerAccessMemo`.
- Attachment HTTP serving — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go` (`149`): `serveAttachmentFile` → `checkAttachmentPermission`.
- SSE event delivery — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (`115–131`): `SSEHub.Broadcast` → `canReceive`.

---

**Visibility model** (for context): `store/memo.go` (`12–21`) defines `PUBLIC`, `PROTECTED`, `PRIVATE`. Enforcement consistently means: public = open (modulo instance anonymity settings on file routes); protected = authenticated users; private = creator (admin/superuser bypass varies by site — e.g. `checkMemoReadAccess` has no admin bypass, but reactions/attachments/fileserver do).
